name: lanun_adept
description: a Lanun Adept (Fall from Heaven), a dark-skinned pirate mage: long black hair under a red bandana whose knotted tails hang at the back of her head, a gold hoop earring, a long navy-blue coat with gold buttons and white trim, a red sash, a brown leather satchel on a strap across the chest at her screen-left hip, brown boots, and a twisted red-brown driftwood staff topped with a glowing blue crystal in her LEFT hand
hands: the crystal-topped driftwood staff stays upright in her left hand on the screen-right side and her right hand is an empty fist resting near the satchel strap on the screen-left side

flinch.0: impact: hit from the lower-right; head snaps back toward the upper-left, eyes squeezed shut, torso jolts back, both arms jerk outward (her empty right fist flung out to the left, the crystal-topped staff thrown up and out in her left hand), the red bandana tails flicking
flinch.1: recoil extreme: leaning back further, knees bent, the crystal-topped staff dipping, leaning out to the right, her empty right fist still held out

death.1: stagger back: a step back with the near foot, body thrown back, staff arm flung up holding the crystal-topped staff high, her empty right fist drooping
death.2: knees buckle: hips drop, knees fold forward, torso slumps forward, head droops, the crystal-topped staff lowering
death.3: kneeling: on both knees, slumped forward, the crystal end of the staff resting on the ground, her empty right hand hanging by the satchel
death.4: falling back: torso tips back toward the upper-left, the crystal-topped staff slips out of the hand, legs slide forward, the long coat flaring
death.5: hits the ground: lying on her back along the ground, feet toward the lower-right and head toward the upper-left, the red bandana still on her head; the crystal-topped staff lies on the ground at the lower-right; the satchel lies flat beside her
death.6: bounce: head and shoulders lift slightly off the ground, the long coat and the satchel settle
death.7: corpse: lying flat and still on her back, eyes closed, the red bandana on her head, the crystal-topped staff on the ground beside her, its crystal dimmed
